item.title: The illusion of a single party by Eric Teniola
item.description: By Eric TENIOLA A persistent fear in Nigerian politics is the emergence of a single-party system or a sole presidential candidate. Despite recurring anxieties, this outcome has never materialised. While recent party defections may suggest an invincible ruling party, Nigeria’s political history is defined by unexpected twists.
